notes: Text OR image start (t2v and i2v tracks): the frame-wise model natively supports I2V (upstream inference.py --i2v: the image is VAE-encoded as latent 0 and cached as clean context; center-cropped to 832:480 here). 832x480 at 16 fps, one latent (4 frames) per causal block generated live (2 DMD steps 1000/500, the first block 4 steps, shift 5.0). The released checkpoint is a 5-second model: sessions continue past 21 latent frames with upstream's rolling KV cache (local attention 21 latents), which the checkpoint was not trained for. It has no prompt-switch mechanism: the block prompt '<init prompt>\n<latest instruction>' is re-encoded and the cross-attention cache reset at the next block; camera_control text is given as prompt text because the model has no camera input. Mid-session reference images have no model input (reference_update unsupported).
